definitions.gloss: stall; booth (run by students or volunteers at a festival)
definitions.explanation: A temporary food or game stall set up at a school festival, community event, or similar occasion, run by students or members rather than by professional vendors. Literally a "mock shop."

examples.japanese: {模擬店|もぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{模擬店|もぎてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}った→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: Our class sold yakisoba at our stall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧{模擬店|もぎてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: On the day of the school festival, there were long lines at the stalls set up in the schoolyard.

notes:
⟦{模擬|もぎ}→模擬：19836_mogi⟧ (mock, simulated) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). A fixture of the ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧ (school culture festival) and ⟦{学園祭|がくえんさい}→学園祭：19688_gakuensai⟧ (university festival).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {模擬店|もぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to run a stall
- {模擬店|もぎてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a stall
- {模擬店|もぎてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparations for the stall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧: food stall — run by professional vendors at shrine festivals and street markets
- {出店|でみせ}: stall, booth — general word for a temporary shop at any event
